**Contrast and legibility** - The h1 gradient text (#fff → #c4b5fd) sits on a #6366f1 → #8b5cf6 background. White measures 4.47:1 on the left and 4.24:1 on the right. The #c4b5fd end measures about 2.3–2.4:1 against the background, which fails the 3:1 large-text minimum at 56px. The text fades into its own background toward the right. - `color:transparent` has no fallback colour. Where `background-clip:text` isn't supported, the headline is invisible. - The hero paragraph inherits #e5e7eb at 16px. That is 3.6:1 on #6366f1 and 3.4:1 on #8b5cf6, so it fails AA 4.5:1. - `.fine` is 9px in #6b7280 on #0b0b1a, which is 4.0:1 and also fails AA. At 9px it is effectively unreadable, well under a 12px floor. "Terms apply." has no link and doesn't say what the terms are. - The card fill #151530 against the page #0b0b1a is 1.10:1. The cards are nearly invisible without the glow and border. **Visual design** - The three cards each have a 40px glow at 50% indigo, a 4px left accent border and a 12px radius. The glow is larger than the 16px gaps, so the glows overlap and muddy the layout. A radius combined with a left border also gives the curved-inner-edge artifact. - The gradient hero (indigo-500 to violet-500) is the brightest thing on a near-black navy page. It competes with the dark theme instead of belonging to it. - Gradient text sits on a gradient background, so two gradients fight each other. - The palette is the stock Tailwind indigo/violet on dark navy with purple glow, which is the default AI-landing look. **Layout and typography** - There is no `max-width`. Cards and body text run edge to edge, so lines get very long on wide screens. - The cards are three identical full-width stacked blocks. There is no grid and no variation in weight, icon or media. - Spacing is inconsistent: 96px hero padding, then 16px card margins, then a default-margin left-aligned footer line under a centred hero. - The type scale is mostly browser defaults (h2 24px, p 16px) jumping from 56px to 9px. No line-heights are set, and the 56px h1 has no `clamp()`. - Inter is named but never loaded, so most visitors get the generic `sans-serif` fallback. - The page has no viewport meta tag, so mobile renders at about 980px width and scaled down. - It has no `

The hero ends in a paragraph with no action. - Nothing says what "Synergy" is or does. - The copy is buzzword filler: "Unleash", "Revolutionize", "supercharge", "transform", "leverage", "cutting-edge", "best-in-class", "next-generation", "empower", "elevate", "unlock your full potential". None of it is specific. - There are 7 em dashes in about 40 words of body copy. The "X — Y — Z" cadence is a typical LLM tell. - The card headings "Seamless", "Powerful" and "Intuitive" are single adjectives with no feature behind them. "Seamless" also repeats the h1. - The two-word card sentences each end in a "without X / for you" tagline pattern. That's generic parallel structure.
